unit.why: A quoted excerpt from a letter by the tzaddik to his brother R. Alexander of Komarna. It gives a halakhic custom, removing tefillin before a circumcision, and backs it with observed practice of the Seer of Lublin and R. Moshe Leib of Sasov, without any narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: Ends with the section heading 'מערכת ג. זקינינו הרה"ק ר' משה מסאמבור', which belongs to the next division
